Yahoo Scraping Tools

A wrapper around Yahoo's fantasy API to make it do what I needed. Superseded by Elo System.

    View on GitHub →

    I had to write this shit because the guy who wrote the original package is an idiot and I had to write a wrapper to do what I wanted to be done.

    They eventually patched the issues I had and I learned a valuable lesson about open source contributions. This project has since been abandoned in favor of the EloSystem project, which is more comprehensive.
